fails_if: concept-group-candidates scores agreement on raw names (so a mid-label or fixed number breaks the prefix), keeps the trailing hyphen in a key, merges two stems that trim to one key, lets a battery or a lone peer suppress a valid family, emits a battery or a family whose key collides with an existing group, proposes the axis from the trimmed key, ranks by anything but agreement first, or renders a label the worklist loader cannot read
note: Families from the artifact source, register 6 (`foretag`). Foldable: morsak1-3, flop1-3 (number mid-label), tillsyn-1-skolbarn-1-3 (a fixed `1` in every name), foo-1-3 (beside the battery peer foo4-6, raw stem `foo`), kod3/7/11 (sparse: numeric axis, values padded to the widest suffix), sun-niva2000/2010 and inkomst1-2000/2010 (years on a non-digit raw stem: vintage), diag1-2 (quotes and a backslash in the name), ink1-2 (mixed-case shared prefix, lower agreement), the existing f1/f2 (both `GenericVar`) and dodsorsak1-3: the artifact's literal `[[group]] dodsorsak-forsta` claims dodsorsak1, but the case passes the curation that built the artifact, where every literal `[[group]]` is an accepted scope, so its members stay eligible and the run 1-3 is ordinal. Dropped: q1-3 (a battery, counted), artal-person-1-3 beside artal-person4-6 (both qualify and trim to one key: a trim collision), register 4's first1/first2 (key `first` is the partition's edge group; counted once as a collision, not as a battery although the names disagree), solo1 (one suffix) and agi1lonfink/agi2lonfink (no trailing digits). Order: agreement descending, then member count descending, then register and key, the generator's documented ranking. Every member's label is its bare suffix. An already-grouped member and the accepted-family re-emit are `an-accepted-group-re-emits-only-under-the-tree-that-declares-it`. The old newline-in-a-name case is unreachable: a newline cannot travel through the Registerinformation source.
